headline: Melting Norwegian Ice Gives Up 48 Ancient Arrow Parts in Two-Decade Search
summary: Researchers in southern Norway have spent 20 years checking glaciers for buried artifacts. Their latest haul is 48 arrowheads and shafts, made from various materials and dating to different eras.

headline: Neighbors and Officers Honored After Pulling Elderly Driver From Sinking Car
summary: During an August storm in Illinois, an older woman's car slid into a water-filled basin and began going under. Several bystanders swam out to her, and four Champaign police officers joined them.
